title: Antigravity Seven-Task Requirements & Dual-Mode Procedural Inventory
summary: Seven task inventories mapping every prior stage, check, approval, output and recovery rule to retained, corrected or explicitly superseded behavior across both scheduled and interactive modes.

rollback_governance.rejection_rationale: Wildcard copy cp docs/plans/scheduled_task_review_sources/*.md automations/prompts/ fails closed because filenames do not match: 4 out of 7 tasks have different basenames between the archive and canonical prompt paths (graph_hygiene_agent.md vs knowledge_graph_hygiene_scheduled_task.md, pr_queue_observer_prompt.md vs pr_queue_observer_scheduled_task.md, storage_hygiene_agent.md vs storage_repository_hygiene_scheduled_task.md, worktree_coverage_agent.md vs worktree_coverage_cleanup_scheduled_task.md). Furthermore, the archive directory includes README.md, which would overwrite automations/prompts/README.md with unrelated index content. Running the wildcard copy leaves 4 compressed prompt files completely untouched and adds 7 orphaned files. Rollback and restoration must be strictly deterministic per-task file mappings.

knowledge_graph_hygiene.title: Knowledge Graph Hygiene Agent
knowledge_graph_hygiene.scheduled_behavior: Full audit, preview, exact findings/handoff; apply nothing to live graph; end with OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED if issues found or COMPLETE if clean
knowledge_graph_hygiene.interactive_behavior: Review waves; approve scoped repair via atomic ask_user_question; verify and recover

requirements.name: Pre-flight Environment & Runtime Inventory
requirements.prior_behavior: Run python -m dual_pipeline.runtime_evidence inventory; record runtime root, active generation, embedding backend, model; read active_pair.json and record PRE_GRAPH_SHA256 and generation.
requirements.remediation_notes: Preserved from canonical baseline. Validates environment isolation and captures immutable pre-flight hash baseline.

requirements.name: Pre-Hygiene State Snapshot & Lock Diagnostics
requirements.prior_behavior: Take graphdb_snapshot_state (id pre-hygiene-<date>), write to reports/hygiene/pre_snapshot_<MM-DD-YYYY>.json, run graphdb_diagnose_locks, verify PRAGMA integrity_check == ok and PRAGMA foreign_key_check returns 0 rows.
requirements.remediation_notes: Preserves mandatory pre-snapshot file and lock check before inspection.

requirements.name: 14-Table Baseline Accounting & Grounding Ratio
requirements.prior_behavior: Record baseline counts for all 14 tables (node, source, source_version, extraction_run, evidence_item, assertion, assertion_evidence, search_document, search_fts, audit_event, dense_vector, sparse_weight, colbert_token, retrieval_record), orphan count, and grounding ratio.
requirements.remediation_notes: Essential accounting floor lost in compression; restored as mandatory check.

requirements.name: Graphdb Rollback Copy Creation
requirements.prior_behavior: Before any change, create a rollback copy of the graph file and active_pair.json under backups/hygiene_<MM-DD-YYYY>/ after a WAL checkpoint; record copy hash.
requirements.remediation_notes: Guarantees zero-risk recovery before any live mutation can occur.

requirements.name: Five Adversarial Reviewers Discovery
requirements.prior_behavior: Execute discovery using graphdb-inspector on live graph with 5 reviewers: Structural Inspector (duplicates, orphans), Timeline Detective (bad dates, contradictions), Fact-Checker (missing evidence links), Security Officer (unauthorized changes; check hitl_decision_ledger.json for intentional duplicates), and Presiding Judge (weigh findings, discard false alarms).
requirements.remediation_notes: All five reviewer roles must be explicitly declared and executed.

requirements.name: Isolated Remediation Branch / Worktree Creation
requirements.prior_behavior: If remediation is required, create an isolated branch/worktree (e.g. git checkout -b fix/graph-hygiene-remediation-<MM-DD-YYYY>) before writing any fix script. Never edit on main.
requirements.remediation_notes: Enforces Invariant 8 (no direct commits or edits on main).

requirements.name: Wave-Based Implementation Plan & Dry-Run Preview
requirements.prior_behavior: Write implementation_plan.md with sequential waves (scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, check command); run each wave as dry-run preview first showing projected counts in plain English without writes.
requirements.remediation_notes: Standard wave-based execution with zero speculative writes.

requirements.name: Atomic HITL Wave Approval Gate
requirements.prior_behavior: In MODE: interactive, present each wave via ask_user_question one wave at a time with plain-English options, recommended option, and confidence score. In MODE: scheduled, apply NOTHING, terminate with OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED if findings exist or COMPLETE if clean.
requirements.remediation_notes: Scheduled runs must never wait on interactive chat and must never self-approve.

requirements.name: Post-Verification Per Wave with Rollback on Failure
requirements.prior_behavior: Verify PRAGMA integrity_check == ok, FK violations == 0, orphan count <= baseline, grounding ratio >= baseline (100% on touched assertions), sidecars IN_SYNC, vector health HEALTHY, itemized assertion delta matches approved plan. If any check fails, restore rollback copy and report BLOCKED reason POST_VERIFICATION_FAILED.
requirements.remediation_notes: Rigorous gate preventing dirty or corrupted graph state.

requirements.name: Plain-English Completion Report & 14-Table Delta Output
requirements.prior_behavior: Output Executive Summary, Five Reviewers findings, Wave Implementation Status Table, Granular Graph DB Delta Table (14 tables, applied before/after), Itemized Assertions Table, fingerprint explanation. Missing data fails closed with POST_DELTA_MISSING.
requirements.remediation_notes: Correct export runner binding: export pointed to a test verifier instead of real audit runner.

storage_repository_hygiene.title: Storage & Repository Clutter Hygiene Agent
storage_repository_hygiene.scheduled_behavior: Complete inventory, retention/pinning, sealed candidates; report-only without mutation; end with COMPLETE or OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED
storage_repository_hygiene.interactive_behavior: Review categories G0-G7; exact subset filtering; quarantine, verify, restore

requirements.name: Phase 0 Preamble & Path Roles
requirements.prior_behavior: Mode detection (default SCHEDULED), path role separation ($REPO_ROOT vs $WT chore/storage-hygiene-<MM-DD-YYYY>), tooling preflight, pre-run baseline recording, global invariants enforcement.
requirements.remediation_notes: Restores strict separation between repository root and governed worktree.

requirements.name: Target Scope Classification & Active Generation Pinning
requirements.prior_behavior: Classify target scopes: Scope A1 (Generations: active pinned, older unpinned are candidates), Scope A2 (Audio cache: output/transcript_cache/), Scope B1 (reports/), Scope B2 (Repository root clutter), Scope C (Stale hygiene worktrees, report-only).
requirements.remediation_notes: Active generation must always be pinned and immune to quarantine.

requirements.name: Planning Run & Candidate Sealing with SHA-256
requirements.prior_behavior: Execute dry-run inventory via python tools/storage_hygiene_core/apply.py --dry-run; emit manifest to reports/storage_hygiene/<run_id>/manifest.json; record SHA-256 digests of all candidate files.
requirements.remediation_notes: Dry-run inventory seals candidate digests before any decision or movement.

requirements.name: Scheduled Mode Read-Only Inventory Execution
requirements.prior_behavior: In SCHEDULED mode: run planning inventory only; emit report to reports/storage_hygiene/scheduled_<date>.md; apply zero file movements or deletions; terminate with COMPLETE (or OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED if candidates found).
requirements.remediation_notes: Unattended cron must never execute quarantine moves or git deletions.

requirements.name: Atomic HITL Gates G0 through G7
requirements.prior_behavior: In INTERACTIVE mode: present atomic ask_user_question gates one at a time: G0 (Category selection), G1 (Generation candidates subset), G2 (Audio cache subset), G3 (Reports subset), G4 (Root clutter subset), G5 (Stale worktrees), G6 (Execution confirmation), G7 (Post-mutation verify/rollback confirmation). Record choices in hitl_decision_ledger.json.
requirements.remediation_notes: Restores full G0-G7 atomic selection flow dropped in 68ba6d56c.

requirements.name: Filtered Plan Construction
requirements.prior_behavior: Construct a filtered plan JSON restricting candidates strictly to the approved subset across categories (compensating for apply_quarantine taking all A1/A2 candidates by default).
requirements.remediation_notes: Critical safety mechanism to prevent bulk unapproved moves.

requirements.name: Pre-Apply Drift & Safety Re-check
requirements.prior_behavior: Immediately before quarantine execution, re-verify candidate file hashes against planning digests and verify active generation has not changed. If hash mismatch detected, abort with DRIFT_DETECTED.
requirements.remediation_notes: Prevents race conditions or concurrent modifications from moving altered files.

requirements.name: Non-Destructive Quarantine Move (A1/A2)
requirements.prior_behavior: Move approved A1 and A2 files to .quarantine/<run_id>/ preserving directory structure; emit quarantine receipt.
requirements.remediation_notes: Files are never permanently deleted; quarantine preserves full recovery path.

requirements.name: Git Actions for Reports & Clutter (B1/B2)
requirements.prior_behavior: Perform git rm/clean for approved B1/B2 files strictly inside isolated worktree $WT; never commit to main.
requirements.remediation_notes: Confines all git index modifications to feature worktree.

requirements.name: Zero-Graph-Mutation Proof & Post-Checks
requirements.prior_behavior: Re-run runtime evidence inventory and verify active graph SHA-256 is byte-identical to pre-run baseline. Any mutation fails closed.
requirements.remediation_notes: Proves storage hygiene never touched live graph data.

requirements.name: Rollback Procedure from Quarantine Manifest
requirements.prior_behavior: On operator request or any failed post-check, atomic restore of quarantined files back to original locations using quarantine manifest; revert worktree branch commits.
requirements.remediation_notes: Guarantees zero data loss with instant reversibility.

requirements.name: Exhaustive Reason-Code Catalog
requirements.prior_behavior: Include exhaustive verbatim reason codes: CLEAN_NO_ACTION, QUARANTINE_APPLIED, MUTATION_ROLLED_BACK, DRIFT_DETECTED, UNAUTHORIZED_WRITE_BLOCKED, etc.
requirements.remediation_notes: Standardized reason codes for deterministic parsing.

weekly_market_intelligence.title: Weekly Market Intelligence Agent
weekly_market_intelligence.scheduled_behavior: Research, briefing compilation, active ingestion intent; emits pending approval request when unauthenticated; terminates cleanly without waiting for chat input
weekly_market_intelligence.interactive_behavior: Review exact delta; authentic human approval; resume run through publication and activation

requirements.name: Stage 0 Pre-flight Baseline
requirements.prior_behavior: Read-only preflight: runtime evidence inventory, read active_pair.json (PRE_GRAPH_SHA256, generation), take graphdb_snapshot_state (id pre-weekly-MM-DD-YYYY), diagnose locks, verify PRAGMA integrity_check == ok, FK violations == 0, 14-table baseline counts.
requirements.remediation_notes: Establishes verified pre-run baseline before research and ingestion.

requirements.name: Stage 1 Bounded Web Research
requirements.prior_behavior: Execute 3 to 5 bounded search_web calls focusing on Apex Global, Apex Utility, NEER, FPSC, FERC regulatory and market intelligence.
requirements.remediation_notes: Controlled research budget prevents search loop exhaustion.

requirements.name: Stage 2 Structured Briefing Compilation
requirements.prior_behavior: Compile structured intelligence document: documents/market_intelligence/weekly_update_MM-DD-YYYY.md with sections: Executive Summary, Market Intelligence Signals, Decision Intelligence Framing (with Observed At / Stale After dates), Source Provenance table.
requirements.remediation_notes: Standardized document artifact formatted for pipeline ingestion.

requirements.name: Stage 3 Governed Ingestion with Active Intent
requirements.prior_behavior: Run python nee.py ingest-document with --project project_nexus, --audiences 'internal_slalom,nee-engineering', --provider llm, --max-judge-retries 2, --enforce-worktree. Produces graph_delta_preview.json and graph_delta_preview.md.
requirements.remediation_notes: Active ingestion intent baseline preserved from 96a0ee879; supersedes archive dry-run-only.

requirements.name: Archive Dry-Run-Only Policy Superseded
requirements.prior_behavior: Archive specified --dry-run-graph flag forcing zero graph mutation in all cases.
requirements.remediation_notes: The older archive's dry-run-only policy is superseded by the active ingestion approval continuation baseline.

requirements.name: Stage 4 Post-Verification & Approval Request Persistence
requirements.prior_behavior: If CLI returns status: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL': verify approval_request_id and request file exists under approval_requests/<approval_request_id>.json; record directive_id and proposed_delta_digest; verify graph remains unchanged pending approval. Scheduled run terminates cleanly without hanging.
requirements.remediation_notes: Scheduled runs persist the resumable approval request and exit without blocking on chat.

requirements.name: Stage 5 Completion Card
requirements.prior_behavior: Emit Completion Card in chat with Document path, Terminal Outcome (COMPLETE, AWAITING_APPROVAL, BLOCKED), Approval Request details, Projected Delta Table, Itemized Assertions Table, Stage Status Table, Top 3 Strategic Takeaways.
requirements.remediation_notes: Corrected contradiction where weekly decline was mislabeled as no-op complete; decline records DECLINED.

requirements.name: Stage 6 Interactive Approval & Continuation
requirements.prior_behavior: In MODE: interactive: check preconditions (AWAITING_APPROVAL, graph unchanged, production pair active, rollback copy created in backups/weekly_market_intel_MM-DD-YYYY/). Call ask_user_question ONCE atomically. On approval, resume same run through publication and activation.
requirements.remediation_notes: Operator review resumes the existing run; never requires duplicate extraction or re-prompting.

requirements.name: Reconciliation of Export Readiness & Registration
requirements.prior_behavior: Export claimed 'Ready for overwrite/paste' while weekly prompt header explicitly prohibited autonomous registration.
requirements.remediation_notes: Export prompt restored from compressed 38-line stub to full 162-line procedural body.

worktree_coverage_cleanup.title: Worktree Coverage & Cleanup Agent
worktree_coverage_cleanup.scheduled_behavior: Enumerate directories and stashes; protect deliverables/recovery; report coverage to JSON/MD; end with COMPLETE or OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED
worktree_coverage_cleanup.interactive_behavior: Per-item recovery or cleanup selection; dry-run confirm-token governed action; rescan

requirements.name: Zero Data Loss Invariant for Meeting Deliverables
requirements.prior_behavior: Never delete, prune, or overwrite any directory containing uncommitted meeting deliverables (01_*, output/**, transcripts, audio). Deliverables can only be recovered into authentic Git branches.
requirements.remediation_notes: Strict protection of production deliverables against automated pruning.

requirements.name: Confirmation-Token Bound Pruning
requirements.prior_behavior: Destructive or pruning commands require an explicit, cryptographically verifiable --confirm-token generated by python tools/pr_governance.py prune-worktrees --dry-run.
requirements.remediation_notes: Prevents unverified or accidental worktree deletion via cryptographically verifiable confirm token; obsoletes stale prune-worktrees command.

requirements.name: Pre-flight Worktree & Stash Inventory
requirements.prior_behavior: Check git status and branch. Run inventory inspection: python tools/pr_governance.py list --worktree-only --json. Verify all .worktrees/ entries and stashes are accounted for under INV-WT-COVERAGE.
requirements.remediation_notes: Full enumeration of all worktrees and stashes via supported inventory command; obsoletes stale list --worktree-only command.

requirements.name: Scheduled Mode Read-Only Coverage Reporting
requirements.prior_behavior: In SCHEDULED mode: write coverage output to reports/worktree_coverage/coverage_<MM-DD-YYYY>.json. If worktrees have ORPHAN_DELIVERABLES, do NOT prune; output Executive Summary highlighting orphans and terminate with OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED. If clean, terminate with COMPLETE.
requirements.remediation_notes: Automated run provides complete visibility without executing deletions.

requirements.name: Interactive Mode Per-Item Decision & Recovery Flow
requirements.prior_behavior: In INTERACTIVE mode: for each item in priority tier W: if ORPHAN_DELIVERABLES, present recovery options via ask_user_question (Option 1: Recover to dedicated branch feat/<slug>, Option 2: Quarantine deliverables, Option 3: Leave for manual inspection) and record choice in hitl_decision_ledger.json. If EMPTY_STUB or MERGED_BRANCH, run dry-run to obtain confirm token, present pruning option via ask_user_question, and execute prune-worktrees with --confirm-token. Re-run inventory to verify clean state.
requirements.remediation_notes: Restores per-item recovery action sequence dropped in compressed prompt.

requirements.name: Worktree Implementation Status Table
requirements.prior_behavior: Emit final report featuring Executive Summary, Worktree & Stash Coverage Status, and Wave Implementation Status Table.
requirements.remediation_notes: Standardized executive reporting format.

repository_antipattern_audit.title: Repository Anti-Pattern & Architecture Auditor
repository_antipattern_audit.scheduled_behavior: Complete bounded audit suite; durable findings; scorecard generation; end with COMPLETE or OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED
repository_antipattern_audit.interactive_behavior: Select refactoring waves; approve scoped remediations via ask_user_question; patch and verify in isolated worktree

requirements.name: Safety Rules & Worktree Isolation Invariant
requirements.prior_behavior: Zero Direct-to-Main Invariant (never audit or mutate on main; run in dedicated worktree chore/repository-antipattern-audit-<stamp>); Zero Graph Mutation Invariant (audits are strictly static analysis and AST inspection); No Unsolicited Refactoring.
requirements.remediation_notes: Enforces strict isolation of architectural audits from production main and graph data.

requirements.name: Four-Tool Bounded Discovery Suite
requirements.prior_behavior: Execute discovery tools: .venv/bin/python tools/audit_agentic_boundaries.py, .venv/bin/python tools/run_governance_linters.py, .venv/bin/python tools/lint_anti_hardcoding.py, .venv/bin/python tools/audit_governance_harmonization.py --output-dir reports/governance-harmonization.
requirements.remediation_notes: Corrected tooling references to reconcile with active repository linters.

requirements.name: Executive Health Scorecard Output
requirements.prior_behavior: Output Executive Health Scorecard evaluating 4 dimensions: Architecture Health, Agentic Integrity, Complexity Debt (module line budgets <=400 lines), and Refactor Risk.
requirements.remediation_notes: Standardized executive summary dimensions.

requirements.name: Scheduled Mode Execution & High-Severity Handoff
requirements.prior_behavior: In SCHEDULED mode: run discovery tools; emit scorecard and findings; if high-severity anti-patterns exist (monolithic modules >400 lines, credential SSOT violations), terminate with OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED and instruct operator to run in interactive mode; if clean, terminate with COMPLETE.
requirements.remediation_notes: Automated schedule reports findings without mutating codebase.

requirements.name: Interactive Mode Remediation Wave Selection & Approval
requirements.prior_behavior: In INTERACTIVE mode: present findings scorecard and itemized anti-pattern clusters; for each priority remediation wave, present calibrated options via ask_user_question; log decisions in hitl_decision_ledger.json; execute approved wave plan or produce finalized audit report artifact.
requirements.remediation_notes: Restores interactive remediation selection lost in compression.

requirements.name: Granular Anti-Pattern Inventory & Wave Table
requirements.prior_behavior: Output Granular Anti-Pattern Inventory covering module size overruns, credential isolation, layer boundaries, and the Wave Implementation Status Table.
requirements.remediation_notes: Ensures all architectural findings are transparently itemized.

ssot_drift_remediation.title: Daily SSOT Drift Remediation Agent
ssot_drift_remediation.scheduled_behavior: Configuration, hardcoding, and boundary checks; bounded scan; handoff; end with COMPLETE or OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED
ssot_drift_remediation.interactive_behavior: Approve bounded repair; execute in refactor/ worktree; rerun checks; retain failure evidence

requirements.name: Phase 1 Bounded Scope Analysis
requirements.prior_behavior: Scan bounded context or recently modified files to prevent context exhaustion; check configuration drift (.env.example vs config.py vs runtime usage); check SSOT violations respecting domain boundaries; check hardcoded magic numbers and paths.
requirements.remediation_notes: Preserves bounded scan policy and domain boundary respect.

requirements.name: Secret Flagging Without Auto-Remediation
requirements.prior_behavior: If hardcoded credentials, API keys, or active secrets are identified, DO NOT auto-remediate. Flag for human review; never output credential values in plans, logs, or reports.
requirements.remediation_notes: Enforces Invariant 4 (Credential Isolation & Zero Egress).

requirements.name: Phase 2 Wave-Based Planning & HITL Gate
requirements.prior_behavior: Develop strict wave-based implementation plan (implementation_plan.md) with Objective, Deliverables, Acceptance Criteria, Runtime Receipt command. Stop and request HITL approval before proceeding to implementation.
requirements.remediation_notes: Planning mode requires operator review before code modifications.

requirements.name: Phase 3 Governed Refactor Worktree Execution
requirements.prior_behavior: Create worktree via python tools/pr_governance.py start refactor/daily-drift-fix-<date> (refactor/ taxonomy). Execute wave plan sequentially within worktree. Mandatory testing after each wave.
requirements.remediation_notes: Enforces refactor/ branch taxonomy and worktree isolation.

requirements.name: Wave Abort & Immediate Reversion on Test Failure
requirements.prior_behavior: If tests fail, abort the wave and revert changes immediately; do not proceed to next wave; retain failure evidence.
requirements.remediation_notes: Fail-closed recovery on test breakage.

requirements.name: Mode Differentiation (Scheduled vs Interactive)
requirements.prior_behavior: In SCHEDULED mode: run Phase 1 only, report violations, apply NOTHING, end with OPERATOR_INPUT_REQUIRED if drift detected or COMPLETE if clean. In INTERACTIVE mode: run Analysis, Planning, and Implementation phases with per-wave HITL approvals.
requirements.remediation_notes: Explicit dual-mode rule added from archive specification.

requirements.name: Branch Review & PR Queue Submission
requirements.prior_behavior: Generate summary of branch readiness via python tools/pr_governance.py review <branch> and submit PR queue summary.
requirements.remediation_notes: Integration with governed PR queue pipeline.

pr_queue_observer.title: Antigravity PR Queue Observer
pr_queue_observer.scheduled_behavior: Meaningful-change detection; quiet unchanged runs; observation-only authority
pr_queue_observer.interactive_behavior: On-demand explanation and inspection with observation-only authority; interactive mode explicitly qualified

requirements.name: Absolute Read-Only Observation Authority
requirements.prior_behavior: Changes NO branches, plans, policy, source, stashes, graph data, or worktree registrations. Performs analysis and notification assessment only in BOTH scheduled and interactive modes.
requirements.remediation_notes: Read-only authority is invariant across both modes.

requirements.name: Single-Run Lock Acquisition & Release
requirements.prior_behavior: Acquire single-run file lock at reports/pr_queue_observer/observer.lock; if held by active PID, abort with ObserverLockCollisionError; release lock on teardown.
requirements.remediation_notes: Prevents concurrent execution collisions.

requirements.name: Snapshot Collection & Decision Evaluation
requirements.prior_behavior: Run python -B tools/pr_queue_observer.py --json or invoke run_observation(repo_root=ROOT); collect QueueSnapshot and evaluate decisions.
requirements.remediation_notes: Engine collects registered worktrees, stashes, and branch progress.

requirements.name: Comparison Against Last Accepted Snapshot
requirements.prior_behavior: Compare current snapshot against reports/pr_queue_observer/last_accepted_snapshot.json; compute rank transitions, newly introduced branches/worktrees/stashes, progress reversals, and failure signatures.
requirements.remediation_notes: State comparison drives meaningful change detection.

requirements.name: Notification Deduplication & Quiet Unchanged Runs
requirements.prior_behavior: In SCHEDULED mode: if terminal_outcome == 'NO_NOTIFICATION', log run receipt quietly and emit zero alert text; notify only on meaningful changes, new work, lost progress, or required HITL decisions.
requirements.remediation_notes: Prevents spamming chat during unattended recurring runs.

requirements.name: Interactive Observation & On-Demand Explanation
requirements.prior_behavior: PR observer registry previously excluded interactive mode. Explicit interactive mode allows operator on-demand inspection, detailed explanation of blockers, rank changes, and uncommitted stashes.
requirements.remediation_notes: Interactive mode explicitly added to specification and task registry with read-only authority.

requirements.name: Host Sleep Tolerance & Zero Replay Storms
requirements.prior_behavior: Tolerates laptop sleep intervals without executing retroactive replay storms; preserves last accepted snapshot.
requirements.remediation_notes: Essential for developer laptop scheduled execution.

requirements.name: Explicit Registration Authority Precondition
requirements.prior_behavior: Repository prompts alone do not establish registration; autonomous registration is forbidden; registration requires explicit operator instruction.
requirements.remediation_notes: Requires human authorization before schedule registration.
